title: designer_routed
description: The model for the issue's design step was chosen. Written by callum-flow-designer-route before each design. Issues routed by hash are the fair sample for comparing the models.

model.description: The model alias chosen. The control is the designer's frontmatter model (opus); the treatment is sonnet.

reason.description: label: a model:<alias> label on the issue; default: no Sonnet share is set; hash: the issue's bucket against the Sonnet share; fallback: the repo or the labels could not be read.

bucket.description: hash: the issue's stable bucket, 0 to 99 (sonnet, the treatment, when below sonnet_pct); null otherwise.

sonnet_pct.description: The configured share of issues routed to Sonnet (the treatment; the control is opus), in percent. Null only when the route tool could not run and logged a fallback.
